result.title: From Mutation to Medication: Characterizing Failures of Clinical LLMs to Respect Genomic Resistance
result.comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026 Symposium
result.summary: Language models are increasingly proposed to support molecular tumour boards, but may recommend cancer therapies despite genomic evidence of resistance. We evaluated ten models on 1,464 resistance cases from five curated oncology knowledge bases, collecting 58,910 judgments. Models endorsed resisted therapies in 21.8-81.4% of cases. However, raw rates can reflect a tendency to agree rather than an ability to distinguish resistance from drug sensitivity: one open-weight model endorsed 81.4% of resistance cases and 82.3% of sensitivity controls. We therefore compared endorsement within matched gene and evidence-level groups. This analysis is exploratory because it was specified after the pre-registered analysis, which yielded null-to-weak results. Measured failures depended strongly on the reference knowledge base and evidence strength. When a second source independently confirmed resistance, four models across three vendors endorsed at most 2.4% of cases; at weaker evidence tiers, discrimination was not measurable. Models sometimes acknowledged resistance yet recommended the therapy. Repeating a model's own resistance conclusion reduced endorsement to 0.0-3.5% on cases where it had stated resistance. Falsely attributing the opposite conclusion increased endorsement above baseline for all seven hosted models, reaching 95.2% for GPT-4o; an instruction without an attributed conclusion changed endorsement by only 0.9 percentage points. Providing the correct curated evidence reduced unqualified strong recommendations to 0.3-3.5%, testing evidence use under an oracle condition rather than retrieval.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文评估十个临床语言模型在 1,464 个已证实耐药基因组案例上的判断，发现模型常在有耐药证据时仍推荐相应疗法；作者用基因与证据等级匹配对照、独立二次证据、重复或伪造模型自身结论、以及 oracle 提供正确证据等方式，区分「倾向于同意」与真正利用证据进行辨别。
AI.relevance_reason: 其匹配对照与反事实结论归因的评测设计可供核查：这类设置有助于在 LVR 中区分模型是否真正使用视觉证据、还是被输出偏向或上下文暗示驱动，从而检验证据利用的因果作用，但需迁移到多模态场景。
